svg.title: About me
svg.desc: I'm a Computer Science student at Benha University and a backend developer from Egypt. I started out building REST APIs and full web apps with PHP, Laravel and MySQL, and I'm now growing into the .NET world with C# and Entity Framework Core. I care about clean code, clear design and software that is easy to maintain. University: Computer Science, Benha University · GPA 3.8 / 4.0. Now: .NET Diploma at Route, C#, OOP, LINQ, EF Core. Before: Backend development, PHP, Laravel & MySQL. Coursework: Machine Learning, Python & Image Processing. Looking for: Opportunities & internships, Backend and .NET roles.
